opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements.
opportunities.summary: Cara's Fellowship Programme provides temporary refuge for academics at risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death, working with a network of 135 universities and research institutes to place them in temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements (mostly in the UK) for 2- or 3-year awards as standard, until they can return home. Cara checks applications, helps identify host institutions, negotiates placements, allocates additional funding, and assists with visas and practical arrangements for the fellow and accompanying family.
